## 2. Energy feasibility bound

If every alive node sends one L-bit packet per round, a node can never live longer than E0 / (L · Eelec) rounds, even at zero distance and never serving as CH.

| Packet size L | Upper bound on any node's lifetime (rounds) | Paper ViTAL FND range | Paper ViTAL LND range |
|---|---|---|---|
| 800 bits | 12500 | 3000–4900 | 4050–7600 |
| 4000 bits | 2500 | 3000–4900 | 4050–7600 |
